title: Edit the file repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts and no other file. Do not edit docs-align-tick.t
description: Edit the file repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts and no other file. Do not edit docs-align-tick.ts. In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts there is exactly one occurrence of this line, inside the accuracy invariant branch:   const shapeContext = /\b(shape|resolver)\b/i;   Replace that single line with:   const shapeContext = /\b(shapes?|resolvers?)\b/i;   That is the entire change. Why: the current pattern cannot match the plural words "shapes" or "resolvers", because \b after "shape" requires a non-word character and the plural s is a word character. The guard immediately following it inside the same loop already accepts the plural, written as /(?:shapes?\s+`[^`]+`|`[^`]+`\s+(?:\w+\s+)*shape)/, so the two contradict each other and every plural-phrased documentation line is discarded before the accepting guard runs. Verified live against the running resolver: a document containing "serves the shape `totallyMadeUpShape`" produces an accuracy finding, while the same sentence written "serves the shapes `totallyMadeUpShape`" produces none. Change only that one regex literal in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts.
